description: Implementation of the FFMPEGDispatch interface for dynamically loaded or globally available FFmpeg symbols, including symbol loading, singleton management, and versioning.

classes.name: FFMPEGDispatch
classes.description: Class responsible for loading FFmpeg symbols dynamically and providing a singleton interface.

methods.name: FFMPEGDispatch
methods.description: Constructor that loads FFmpeg symbols and registers all codecs.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of FFMPEGDispatch.

methods.name: RegisterSpecialization
methods.description: Registers specific FFmpeg library versions; always returns true in this implementation.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the FFmpeg dispatch object is valid; always true.

methods.name: specialization_version
methods.description: Returns the version identifier for the linked FFmpeg library.
